jess_ops: FYI flagged by audit logs: a GCP service account key was embedded in a dataset bundle uploaded to gs://datasets/partner-ingest/2026-03-21. The key belonged to proj-redwood-dataset:sa-ds-ingest@proj-redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com.

ryan_ds: how was it embedded? a file? metadata?

jess_ops: looks like the ingestion script `export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/workspace/creds.json` accidentally wrote creds into the bundle tar. The bundle contains creds.json at path ingest/creds.json.

leo_security: omg. who had access to that bucket? public? third-party vendor?

jess_ops: bucket is internal to partner ingest pipeline but the partner's automation pulls from it. We need to assume exposure to partner infra. Treat as P0 rotate & scoping.

ana_cloud: small correction: it's ana_cloud :). I'll start rotation. Immediate actions I'm taking: 1) disable the SA key 2) create scoped replacement SA with least perms 3) request partner to confirm deletion from their side

ci-bot: [automated] Created ticket S-5401: "Rotate leaked dataset service-account + audit partner ingest" assigned to cloud (P0). https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/S-5401

ryan_ds: blowing away the bundled artifact and re-uploading sanitized version now. Will share new SHA. Also adding an ingestion test to fail on credentials in archive.

leo_security: We should also: 1) list all buckets that accepted uploads from partner-ingest between 2026-03-15 and 2026-03-22 2) scan repo history for `creds.json` or `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS` writes 3) notify partner to rotate any cached copies.

ana_cloud: SA key disabled. New SA created: sa-ds-ingest-scoped@proj-redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com with only storage.objectViewer on gs://datasets/partner-ingest/ingest-temp and no project-wide roles. Generated new short-lived key for partner using KMS-wrapped OIDC workflow.

ryan_ds: sanitized bundle uploaded: gs://datasets/partner-ingest/2026-03-21/sanitized-bundle.tar.gz sha256: d4f7... . Added pre-check that fails CI if archive contains 'private_key' or 'client_email'. PR: https://github.com/redwood/dataset-ingest/pull/412

security-bot: [automated] Quick scan: found 3 other bundles with `creds.json` pattern in partner-ingest (dev-stage). Creating follow-ups under S-5401.

leo_security: timeline proposal: 6h - key disabled & partner notified (done), 24h - complete artifact sweep and replace flagged bundles, 72h - audit & postmortem.

jess_ops: partner notified via secure channel. They confirmed they pulled the bundle into their staging infra; they've started rotation on their side as well.

ana_cloud: policies I'm pushing: deny on org policy to prevent writes of keys into bucket objects via common filenames (simple content policy), and add a lifecycle rule to quarantine newly uploaded archives for 1 hour pending auto-scan.

ryan_ds: note for dataset team: stop exporting SA env files into workspace root. Use Workload Identity / short-lived tokens or `gcloud auth application-default login` with ephemeral creds.

leo_security: please collect list of any third-party IPs that accessed the object between 2026-03-20T00:00 and 2026-03-22T12:00 and attach to S-5401. We need that for incident severity review.

ci-bot: [automated] Bulk scan started across gs://datasets for `private_key` and `client_email` patterns. ETA ~35m.

security-bot: [automated] Audit log export for proj-redwood-dataset request-authorizations queued.

jess_ops: quick mitigation checklist for teams: rotate any keys, run `./tools/gcloud-bundle-scan --path gs://datasets --pattern client_email` , rebuild and re-upload sanitized bundles, add ingestion gate to CI.

ryan_ds: attaching run IDs and hashes to S-5401: ingest-run-20260318-02 (orig bundle sha: a1b2...), ingest-run-20260321-11 (orig bundle sha: c3d4...).

ana_cloud: partner confirmed deletion of pulled artifact. Still asking for full audit but they will rotate any cached credentials.

leo_security: good triage. We'll keep S-5401 as single source of truth. Postmortem owner: dataset infra (ryan_ds).

jess_ops: closing slack thread for now; follow-ups in S-5401. If you find other leaked SA keys in artifacts DM me or tag @security. :rotating_light:
